set_effect.name: Set effect
set_effect.description: Starts an LED effect with optional color, color list, speed and brightness.

effect.name: Effect
effect.description: Effect to run. 'Off' shows a static color.

color.name: Color
color.description: Base color for blink, strobe and breathe: a name (red, darkorange, …), #RRGGBB or r,g,b.

colors.name: Colors
colors.description: Colors for cycle and fade (names or #RRGGBB).

speed.name: Speed
speed.description: Effect speed in milliseconds (blink/breathe: full period, rainbow: one cycle, cycle/fade: time per color).
